environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running identical Flask monolith in us-west-2c. Split Proxy relay is deployed as a sidecar container on the same host, configured with workspace-level targeting rules. The 'legacy-sql-search-v2' flag definition has kill switch status=ARCHIVED in the Split console with default treatment='off' and the individual targeting rule for rollout was set to 0% with a dependency on 'sql-migration-complete' flag (which evaluates to 'on', blocking the legacy path). The relay syncs flag definitions every 5 seconds via streaming connection to Split cloud. Additionally, the Split Proxy has a stale-flag eviction policy where any flag not updated in >90 days returns the configured default (off). The flag was last modified 147 days ago. Note: the application code's fail-closed default (return 'off' on error) provides defense-in-depth but the primary control is the flag evaluation itself returning 'off' for all contexts.

config.split_proxy: sidecar relay v5.4.1, streaming SSE connection active, stale_eviction_days=90, flag_last_modified=147d_ago
config.network: ALB -> EC2 port 5000, no WAF attached
